title: rosa afzeliana var. grisescens
intro: Rosa afzeliana var. grisescens, commonly known as the Grey-leaved Rose, is a species of rose plant known for its unique greyish foliage and fragrant flowers. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The Grey-leaved Rose is also reported to have therapeutic actions such as calming the nervous system and promoting better sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
